title: 电线的颜色：认得清，更要验得准
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/20_Color code for Electrical Power Cable Electrical Color Code Power Cable Color Co.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/20_Color code for Electrical Power Cable Electrical Color Code Power Cable Color Co/src.py

points.S4: 进口仪器电源线，交电工处理

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一束各种颜色的电线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a bundle of insulated wires in many colors and smiles at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识电线的颜色。
overlay: 电线的颜色：认得清，更要验得准

shots.scene: 相线、零线、地线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a returning arrow and a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 火线、零线、地线，各有颜色。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一台旧仪器，电源线外皮剥开，露出几根颜色不同的线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds an old instrument whose power cord has a broken plug, showing wires of different colors.
shots.narration: 阿杰的旧仪器插头坏了。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起螺丝刀，看着线的颜色比划
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a screwdriver and compares the wire colors, looking unsure.
shots.narration: 他想按颜色自己接个新插头。

shots.scene: 老周摇头，按住螺丝刀
shots.prompt_en: The older man shakes his head and gently takes the screwdriver away.
shots.narration: 老周拦住他：颜色可不一定可靠。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先弄清颜色的意思，再说谁来接。

shots.scene: 一束彩色电线特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a bundle of wires with red, yellow, blue, black, brown and green-yellow insulation. No people.
shots.narration: 电线外皮的颜色，是一种标识。

shots.scene: 老李看着配电箱里的导线点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks into an open distribution box at neatly colored wires and nods.
shots.narration: 看颜色，就能大致分出导线的用途。

shots.scene: 三根导线并排，分别配闪电、回流箭头、接地符号
shots.prompt_en: Three wires side by side, each labeled with an icon: a lightning bolt, a returning arrow and a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 导线分三类。

shots.scene: 电流从相线流向灯泡，再从中性线流回
shots.prompt_en: A simple circuit: current flows from the live wire to a light bulb and returns along the neutral wire. No people.
shots.narration: 相线送电，中性线让电流流回。

shots.scene: 仪器金属外壳连着一根接地线
shots.prompt_en: The metal case of a lab instrument connected by a wire to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 保护导体连着外壳，就是地线。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格，单相栏里红、黄、蓝三段导线
shots.prompt_en: A blank chart with a single-phase column showing a red wire, a yellow wire and a blue wire with an or sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 原片的色标：单相相线用红、黄或蓝。

shots.scene: 地球图标上几个国家被点亮，旁边一个旧时钟
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon with a few regions highlighted next to an old clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这是一些国家和旧线路的做法。

shots.scene: 三相栏：第一根红、第二根黄、第三根蓝
shots.prompt_en: A three-phase column with three wires labeled one, two, three in red, yellow and blue. No people.
shots.narration: 三相线依次是红、黄、蓝。

shots.scene: 三根线首字母组成简称
shots.prompt_en: The three colored wires gather into a neat bundle with a small shorthand tag. No people.
shots.narration: 简称红黄蓝。

shots.scene: 中性线栏：一根黑色导线
shots.prompt_en: A neutral row in the chart showing a single black wire. No people.
shots.narration: 中性线用黑色。

shots.scene: 保护导体栏：一根黄绿条纹导线
shots.prompt_en: A protective conductor row showing a wire with green and yellow stripes. No people.
shots.narration: 地线用黄绿双色。

shots.scene: 黄绿线连到接地符号，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The green and yellow striped wire connects to a ground symbol with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这一条，国内外基本一致。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在新的空白表格前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a new blank color chart.
shots.narration: 我国的色标和原片不一样。

shots.scene: 三根导线：黄、绿、红
shots.prompt_en: Three wires side by side in yellow, green and red, labeled one, two, three. No people.
shots.narration: 三相线依次是黄、绿、红。

shots.scene: 一根淡蓝色导线
shots.prompt_en: A single light blue wire. No people.
shots.narration: 中性线用淡蓝色。

shots.scene: 黄绿条纹导线
shots.prompt_en: A green and yellow striped wire next to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 保护导体用黄绿双色。

shots.scene: 一根仪器电源线剖面：棕、蓝、黄绿三芯
shots.prompt_en: Cross-section of an instrument power cord with three cores: brown, blue and green-yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器电源线常见棕、蓝、黄绿三色。

shots.scene: 空白标准手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standards booklet icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 具体以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 颜色混乱的旧线路，旁边打问号
shots.prompt_en: An old junction box with faded, mismatched wire colors and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 旧线路、改过的线，颜色可能不对。

shots.scene: 只凭颜色就动手的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching for a wire based only on its color, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只看颜色就动手，很危险。

shots.scene: 老李拉下电闸，再用验电笔检测
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing insulating gloves, switches off the breaker, then checks the wires with a voltage tester pen.
shots.narration: 电工要先断电、再验电，确认无电。

shots.scene: 黄绿线接到相线端子的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a green and yellow wire connected to a live terminal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 黄绿线只能当地线，不能挪作他用。

shots.scene: 普通导线冒充地线的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plain black wire attached to the ground terminal pretending to be an earth wire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别的颜色也不能冒充地线。

shots.section_title: 进口仪器电源线，交电工处理
shots.scene: 进口仪器的电源线和本地插座之间有问号
shots.prompt_en: An imported lab instrument with an unfamiliar plug next to a local wall socket, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 进口和旧仪器，线色可能不同。
overlay: 进口仪器电源线，交电工处理

shots.section_title: 进口仪器电源线，交电工处理
shots.scene: 阿杰把仪器交给老李，老李手持空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands the instrument to the facility engineer, who holds up a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 换插头、改接线，交给持证电工。

shots.section_title: 进口仪器电源线，交电工处理
shots.scene: 学生用螺丝刀接线的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student hand wiring a plug with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不要自己动手接电源线。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三根导线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of three wires: live, neutral and ground.
shots.narration: 相线、中性线、地线，颜色各不同。

shots.scene: 国内色标表：黄绿红、淡蓝、黄绿双色
shots.prompt_en: A color chart with yellow, green and red phase wires, a light blue neutral wire and a green-yellow ground wire. No people.
shots.narration: 国内：黄绿红、淡蓝、黄绿双色。

shots.scene: 验电笔和断电开关图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a voltage tester pen and a breaker switched off. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色只是参考，先断电再验电。

shots.scene: 工具箱和操作证图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a toolbox and a blank work permit card. No people.
shots.narration: 接线改线，交给持证电工。

shots.scene: 欣欣把一束整理好的电线放进盒子，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts a neat bundle of colored wires into a box and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 认清颜色，验准再动，下次见！
